name: Let's Relax Spa Krabi (Ao Nang)
nameZh: 乐放松水疗·甲米奥南海滩店
tagline: Trusted Thai spa chain steps from Ao Nang Beach
taglineZh: 泰国知名连锁水疗，奥南海滩近在咫尺
description: The Krabi branch of Thailand's favourite spa chain brings its full menu of Thai massage, aromatherapy and signature packages to Ao Nang. Consistent, professional service with online booking — perfect after a day of island hopping.
descriptionZh: 泰国人气连锁水疗的甲米分店将全套泰式按摩、香薰理疗与招牌套餐带到奥南。服务专业稳定、支持在线预约，是跳岛一日游后的完美放松之选。

name: Royal Palm Spa Krabi (Ao Nang)
nameZh: 皇家棕榈水疗·甲米奥南
tagline: Top-rated Thai massage, head spa and hot stone therapy
taglineZh: 高评分泰式按摩、头部水疗与热石理疗
description: Royal Palm Spa is one of Ao Nang's top-rated massage houses on TripAdvisor, offering traditional Thai massage, aromatherapy, hot stone treatments and a distinctive Japanese-style head spa in clean, comfortable surroundings.
descriptionZh: Royal Palm Spa 是奥南 TripAdvisor 评分最高的按摩馆之一，提供泰式传统按摩、香薰理疗、热石疗法，以及特色的日式头部水疗，环境干净舒适。

name: Radarom Spa
tagline: Local-owned Thai spa with a loyal following
taglineZh: 本地经营的泰式水疗，回头客众多
description: Managed by a local Thai owner, Radarom Spa has built a loyal following in Ao Nang with attentive traditional Thai massage, herbal treatments and scrubs at fair prices. Book ahead during high season — it fills up fast.
descriptionZh: Radarom Spa 由本地泰国老板经营，以细致的泰式传统按摩、草本理疗与磨砂护理和公道的价格在奥南赢得大量回头客。旺季建议提前预约，常常满客。
